issues.description: File filter '*.exe' hides conda/mamba executables on macOS and Linux
issues.detail: In confpage.py the browse-file dialog uses filters='*.exe', which only matches Windows executables. On macOS and Linux, conda/mamba/micromamba have no extension, so users see an empty file picker and cannot select their executable without manually typing the path. Use a platform-aware filter or default to all files.

issues.description: validate_conda substring match accepts unrelated executables
issues.detail: The check `any(tool in out.decode().lower() for tool in ['micromamba','mamba','conda'])` matches any binary whose --version output happens to contain those substrings (e.g., 'anaconda-client', 'anaconda-project'). Anchor on the leading token of the version output or use a stricter regex/prefix match.

issues.description: os.access(X_OK) check is unreliable on Windows and may reject valid conda.exe
issues.detail: validate_conda rejects paths failing os.access(path, os.X_OK). On Windows, X_OK semantics are unreliable for .exe/.bat files depending on ACLs and may return False for legitimate executables. Since run_program will already fail for non-executables, drop the X_OK check or skip it on Windows.

issues.description: Custom conda path is used at kernel launch without re-validation
issues.detail: kernelspec.py reads conda_path from config and uses it directly as conda_exe without checking existence, expanding ~, or re-running validate_conda. A stale, moved, or externally-edited path produces opaque downstream subprocess errors instead of the friendly preferences-pointing message.

issues.description: Unconditional setFocus after select_file affects all browsefile consumers
issues.detail: create_browsefile is shared across many preference pages. Adding edit.setFocus() after every file selection changes focus behavior for every existing caller, not just the new conda field, which can disrupt keyboard navigation and validate_callback flows elsewhere. Gate it behind an opt-in parameter.

issues.description: Custom conda path is not expanded/normalized before use
issues.detail: Paths containing ~ or environment variables (e.g., ~/miniconda3/bin/conda) are passed directly to os.path.isfile, run_program, and downstream subprocess calls without os.path.expanduser/expandvars. Users frequently paste such paths and will see them silently rejected or fail at runtime.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR adds a useful escape hatch for non-standard conda installs and that the structural wiring through config, UI, and kernelspec is sensible. However, four cross-platform/validation concerns are unanimous or near-unanimous: a Windows-only '*.exe' file filter that breaks the picker on macOS/Linux, a loose substring match in validate_conda that accepts unrelated binaries, an unreliable os.access(X_OK) check on Windows, and a custom conda_path that flows into kernel launch without re-validation or path expansion. A shared-widget setFocus change in create_browsefile is also flagged as a wider blast radius than the PR scope warrants.
